title: The Brothers Karamazov
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
summary: Three very different brothers, a sensualist, an intellectual and a novice monk, are tied to their bullying father. When he is murdered, one of them is put on trial and the novel wrestles with faith and doubt.
readIf: you want a monumental novel of ideas that is also a family drama and a murder mystery.
skipIf: you want short or light reading, because it asks a lot of your time and attention.

pairings.reason: A tighter, more focused novel by the same author, built around one man's mind.
Another sweeping family novel built on a story of brothers and the question of free will.
Another giant Russian novel, with a broader view of society and history.
